chunks.name: pprb_attr_val
chunks.sql: SELECT a_agr_collat_mkt_period.host_eks_id AS host_agr_collat_id, a_agr_collat_mkt_period.start_dt, a_agr_collat_mkt_period.end_dt, CAST('mkt_price_amt' AS TEXT) AS attr_name, a_agr_collat_mkt_period.mkt_price_amt AS attr_val_numeric, CAST(NULL AS UUID) AS attr_val_uuid, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS attr_val_bigint FROM s_grnplm_vd_t_bvd_db_dmcl.a_agr_collat_mkt_period WHERE (NOT a_agr_collat_mkt_period.mkt_price_amt IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT a_agr_collat_mkt_period.host_eks_id AS host_agr_collat_id, a_agr_collat_mkt_period.start_dt, a_agr_collat_mkt_period.end_dt, CAST('mkt_price_rub' AS TEXT) AS attr_name, a_agr_collat_mkt_period.mkt_price_rub AS attr_val_numeric, CAST(NULL AS UUID) AS attr_val_uuid, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS attr_val_bigint FROM s_grnplm_vd_t_bvd_db_dmcl.a_agr_collat_mkt_period WHERE (NOT a_agr_collat_mkt_period.mkt_price_rub IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT mkt_prd.host_eks_id AS host_agr_collat_id, mkt_prd.start_dt, mkt_prd.end_dt, CAST('mkt_crncy_id' AS TEXT) AS attr_name, CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS attr_val_numeric, CAST(NULL AS UUID) AS attr_val_uuid, v_crncy.crncy_id AS attr_val_bigint FROM (((s_grnplm_vd_t_bvd_db_dmcl.a_agr_collat_mkt_period AS mkt_prd LEFT JOIN s_grnplm_as_t_didsd_701_vd_dwh.v_crncy AS vc ON ((mkt_prd.mkt_crncy_id = vc.crncy_id))) LEFT JOIN s_grnplm_vd_t_bvd_db_dmcl.d_prvsn_crncy ON ((d_prvsn_crncy.c_idmdmp = vc.crncy_cd))) LEFT JOIN s_grnplm_as_t_didsd_010_vd_dwh.v_crncy AS v_crncy ON (((v_crncy.crncy_cd = d_prvsn_crncy.c_code) AND (v_crncy.info_system_id = 1107)))) WHERE (NOT mkt_prd.mkt_crncy_id IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT t.host_eks_agr_collat_id AS host_agr_collat_id, a.start_dt, a.end_dt, CAST('agr_collat_qlty_cat_type_id' AS TEXT) AS attr_name, CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS attr_val_numeric, a.agr_collat_qlty_cat_type_id AS attr_val_uuid, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS attr_val_bigint FROM (s_grnplm_vd_t_bvd_db_dmcl.a_agr_collat_qlty_period AS a JOIN s_grnplm_vd_t_bvd_db_dmcl.d_agr_collat AS t ON ((a.agr_collat_id = t.agr_collat_id))) WHERE (NOT a.agr_collat_qlty_cat_type_id IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT t.host_eks_agr_collat_id AS host_agr_collat_id, a.start_dt, a.end_dt, CAST('asset_collat_type_id' AS TEXT) AS attr_name, CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS attr_val_numeric, a.asset_collat_type_id AS attr_val_uuid, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS attr_val_bigint FROM (s_grnplm_vd_t_bvd_db_dmcl.a_agr_collat_qlty_period AS a JOIN s_grnplm_vd_t_bvd_db_dmcl.d_agr_collat AS t ON ((a.agr_collat_id = t.agr_collat_id))) WHERE (NOT a.asset_collat_type_id IS NULL)

chunks.name: main
chunks.sql: SELECT t2.agr_collat_id, t1.host_agr_collat_id, t1.start_dt, t1.end_dt, t1.attr_name, t1.attr_val_numeric, t1.attr_val_uuid, COALESCE(t1.attr_val_bigint, CAST((ABS(UUID_HASH(t1.attr_val_uuid))) AS BIGINT)) AS attr_val_uuid2bigint FROM (pprb_attr_val AS t1 JOIN s_grnplm_vd_t_bvd_db_dmslcl.d_agr_collat AS t2 ON ((t1.host_agr_collat_id = t2.host_agr_collat_id)))
